name: com.rtools.highres-screenshot
description: A small Unity editor window for high resolution screenshots, similar to Unreal's HighResShot. Take a shot from the game camera or the scene view at a multiplier (1x-8x) or an explicit resolution, save as PNG or EXR, with a filename prefix and auto incrementing counter and an in-window preview. The window has a Chinese / English switch. Works with Built-in, URP and HDRP (no render pipeline dependency).
